snapshot: WHO African Region. Rolling out universal health coverage (CMU) under the 2026-2030 national health development plan, with one of the larger US America First health agreements in West Africa.

leadership.role: Minister of Health, Public Hygiene and Universal Health Coverage
leadership.name: Pierre N'Gou Dimba

agenda.title: National health plan 2026-2030 and universal coverage
agenda.text: The government leads reforms and coordinates partners under the Plan national de développement sanitaire (PNDS) 2026-2030, while preparing the transition to sustainable domestic financing. Speeding up universal health coverage (CMU) and the quality of care in regional centres of excellence are stated priorities.

agenda.title: US health MoU with growing co-financing
agenda.text: Côte d'Ivoire and the United States signed an America First health MoU on 30 December 2025 worth about US$487 million (272 billion FCFA), with Côte d'Ivoire to mobilise 163 billion FCFA (60%) by 2030. The first steering committee met in July 2026, and a strategic objectives agreement followed in September.

agenda.title: Partnerships aligned to national priorities
agenda.text: At the World Health Assembly (May 2026) the minister called on partners to align with national priorities as international health aid falls. With the World Bank the ministry is focusing on universal coverage, digital health and local production of medicines.
